title: The FOMC says monetary policy actions tend to influence activity, employment, and prices with a lag
summary: The FOMC says monetary policy actions tend to influence activity, employment, and prices with a lag.
body: The statement says policy actions tend to influence economic activity, employment, and prices with a lag, and that sustainably achieving the goals depends on a stable financial system. The source says: "Monetary policy actions tend to influence economic activity, employment, and prices with a lag." The lag is the Committee's stated reason for looking at the outlook and the balance of risks, not a measured number of months in this document.

sources.title: Statement on Longer-Run Goals and Monetary Policy Strategy
sources.author: Federal Open Market Committee
